page.overview:
Who is Tomato Devil?

The |Tomato no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of tomatoes.

The Tomato Devil has a large round red body resembling a tomato, with multiple bulging eyes sprouting its surface in all directions. It stands upon eight human-like arms which emerge from its base and has a large vertical mouth at the center of its body.

Not much is known about the Tomato Devil's personality but presumably like all non-humanoid devils it possesses a great hatred of humans.

The Tomato Devil was walking around a house, when Denji with the help of Pochita went and killed him. Denji then explained to his boss the ability of the Tomato Devil and that he needs to burn its seeds.
